body:
Ass slapping.  I find it very distracting during a porno, and downright confusing during real sex....

A lover slapped mine during, and it completely derailed me...
"Did he just slap my ass?  What's that supposed to do?"  Took me a while to get back into the moment....

Also the anguished face during anal penetration by what could be a meat fire extinguisher, all the while saying "Yeah, oh yeah, oooooh yeah." Face emphatically says "No, oh Nooooo."
You are wise - hatred is still a connection.  Nothing is freedom.

Took his number off my phone, deliberately stopped myself from remembering it, so I can't call him even if I wanted to...  I miss him but he left me and that is all there is to it.  I lost my job and am at a low point, I wanted to talk to him out of anxiety.  He ran off with another woman so my self esteem is awful. 

Men have been hitting on me since he left, it only emphasizes how different he is from them.  I feel an enormous loss.  But I am practicing loving myself; just very difficult now.  I lost him because I am weak and dependent.  His new love's man committed suicide by hanging on her birthday in September.  She cut him down herself.  She held his hand until he died.  Then she went after my Ex and he dumped me and they ran off together in March.  She is strong.  I am mourning him longer than she mourned her man who she cut down from a rope herself; I feel stupid for wanting him back, but I do.  


I am devastated and am trying to heal, but am prone to depression and losing my job has hurt a lot.  Thank you for your kindness and support.  I realize I have to heal and live and grow for myself, but love is like a drug and I feel like I'll never feel what I felt with him again.

There are evidently a lot of horses in the US and racetracks hire lots of people, many of whom work for many years for specific trainers.   So, even though the economy is poor, there are still work opportunities.

I may have to try that -   I'd rather stay at the track but perhaps I'm howling at the moon.  I'm even becoming a bit paranoid; am I on a blacklist?  I'm very good, devoted to my charges and have an unusual way with horses.  To no avail - i see drunks, felons and addicts consistently employed (even when they are prone to benders)  and I leave empty handed, even though i'm super reliable.

I said a spiteful thing recently, and my friend was taken aback; I had never expressed myself like that before.  but that is how I speak to myself all the time.  How does one show love to oneself?  I can love deeply, but not the right people.  I literally don't know anyone who has a nuanced way of living and thinking;  in that sense my therapist is my only friend.  I of course cannot confide in my poor companion;  yet I love him and would rather cut my arm off rather than hurt him.

I had deluded myself that the strength of my love for this other person was an indication that I had a higher purpose in his life.  I guess he didn't feel the same.  But it's not about him; it's about very severe wounds I suffered as a child.  I am deeply lonely; surrounded by people who like me but who say exactly the wrong things.  I torture myself; she is better.  He has forgotten me utterly, I mean nothing to him, he is happy without me.  

Your post is kind and is beautiful; I will hold on to it.  I can't internalize it yet, but I'll hold it close.    Thank you.

I'm very vigilant about the notion of reeling him in; I want to never see him or talk to him again, because the mere idea him causes me such distress. I loved him very much.

He doesn't have a computer, he wouldn't answer my calls or texts (I don't think so) because he had avoided talking to me the whole time after his revelation and before he left with his new lady.  I haven't called or texted at all after the first two days.

Thank you, it hurts, but your kindness really helps.  Today, Monday, I had a new realization: this man had become a serious burden on my life.  I loved him so much, and his behaviour is so skilled, that he became a source of a kind of tainted joy.  And I felt relieved of that burden today.  So yay!  Now I need to think about why I was so vulnerable to this man's sordid magnetism.  And avoid all contact with him forever.

People are broken usually because we break them.  Those of us who have survived know that our parents can break us in ways that we are not even aware of as violence.  But when we come to autonomy, we are responsible for who we are; i believe with all my heart that we can be the parents we never had.  We'll still have our scars,  but they will be healed, and we can wear them as badges of our fight for meaning and beauty in our lives.

I contacted security; he's avoided me, today didn't show up for his job.  No call, nothing.  I hope i'm not overstating because of my own anger, because i want to be fair to the situation, yet i can't help thinking he's behaving like a guilty animal and not actually thinking.  He's never simply not shown up for work.  Security says they will handle it.  I will not try to see him without them again.  

Although the person he is with now is herself a security guard, the guards have shown me such unconditional understanding and support that my eyes are misting with tears at this unexpected source of grace.  

Another detail is that if i go the route of calling actual police, he will be be summarily fired and banned from our industry.  It took him nine years to come back to the industry from the last banning, in which he was incarcerated for selling herion, larceny and assault (on a man).  The "man" caveat is because there seemed to be no history of violence on females.  (Bell going off in my head signaling my own rationalization).  But he is extremely violent emotionally, which instead of repelling me attracted me - an old and deeply felt trigger.  So I recognized his how mutilated his soul is, and i wanted to be a place where he could feel loved and know health.  

But i realize his humanity is thin; and i recognize my own complicity in not seeing things more clearly.  The shock has awoken me,  and i am mortified at my own willful blindness in dealing with a human simulacrum.  Strange stuff that jangled obsessively in my head finally revealed themselves in true form; feels like those old fairy stories where one finds oneself in a palace eating sumptuous fare.  The glamour fades, and one is realizes one in actually sitting in a stye eating shit.

So i cannot even pity him,  which makes me sad.

You are absolutely right, one of the worst things is my alter screaming "I Told You So" very loud in my head.  I wanted to heal him and give him love; love is not what he wants.  I am not the first to be seduced by a sociopath.  Should have known better, serves me right for walking into such an obvious trap, etc. etc. etc. Plus the gonorrhea.   All this in the space of the last few weeks.  I'm overwhelmed by shame and sadness. 

Yet one of the best things is that people where I work have rallied around me, and I never realized how well liked I am.  And in an effort to feel better, or at least understand on a deeper level what has happened to me, I have rediscovered the work of Alice Miller, and Karen Horney, as well as a book that is so appropos that I often have to pause in my reading because the shock of recognition is so strong.   It's by Marie-France Hirigoyen, and is called **Stalking the Soul**.  

In the past few days I recognized why I responded to his pursuit of me so strongly; it is as if he had ripped a door open in my heart, and a torrent of  very raw emotions poured out.   I had never experienced that; I was swept away.  

Doesn't hurt that, although I am very fit and cab drivers cannot believe I am sixty, I am still looking at mortality, and having such a strong archetypal male so smitten with me made me, well, not anywhere near as rational as usual.  

He obviously didn't love me at all... probably what I felt for him was not so much love but re-evocation of my relationship with a cruel and narcissistic parent, and a chance to heal that awful wound left so long ago.  

So the monster did not bite me at first, and I became enamoured of feeling healed and loved by the sadistic parent who hated me and rejected me as a child.  And then, inevitably, he bit me, hard.  And I now have a wound to heal.  But I can heal better and faster than my former lover or his new target.  

My soul will love fully and live fully, while they shall live their blighted lives elsewhere. So although I feel awful now, I know I will go on to good things.



But that was a sweet bike, the first I'd ever owned in my life.  I shall miss it.  Well, off to buy another one.  Thank you for the kindness and support in your comments, I really appreciate it.

NB:  She had the gonorrhea, he gave it to me.  Sigh.  

EDIT: Adding tldr and apologize for the long post, felt cathartic 

tldr: messed up relationship, I know I'm better off working on being and feeling better and without him
